description.t: This course introduces students to the vital role of computers and computer programmers in shaping modern society. It aims to foster a strong foundation in logical formulation techniques essential for programming, while promoting the development of good coding practices. Students will be taught the fundamentals of Java programming and explore significant real-world applications. In line with La Consolacion University Philippines' commitment to forming Christo-centric Catholic professionals , the course integrates Marian Augustinian values in each lesson, ensuring that students not only achieve intellectual growth but also cultivate moral and ethical responsibility in the digital age. This holistic approach nurtures individuals who contribute positively to society, embodying community, humility, and love of service , as exemplified by the Blessed Virgin Mary and Saint Augustine. By the end of the course, students will have created their own Java applications, demonstrating both technical proficiency and a sense of purpose rooted in their Catholic faith.

outcomes.vision: Moved by the Spirit of the Risen Christ, La Consolacion University Philippines, envisions itself to become a catalyst for the wholistic transformational development of Catholic Augustinian Marian graduates rooted in Gospel values.

mission.lead: To achieve the above vision, LCUP commits itself to generate and make available to its Augustinian Marian students, programs and services that will make them:
items: exhibit academic and technical competence in their respective areas of discipline in the local and international environment;
demonstrate their knowledge, critical thinking and creativity by exploring the various avenues of learning and searching for truth;
manifest their willingness to serve specially the marginalized sector of our society;
demonstrate productivity in various areas of learning as responsible citizens of the society; and
live the Gospel values in the varied aspects of their personal and professional lives

pos.text: Articulate and discuss the latest developments in the specific field of practice;
Effectively communicate orally and in writing using both English and Filipino;
